create_exact_dedup_config: create an ExactDedupConfig with a content getter and optional document priority function
run_exact_dedup_signature: run ExactDedupSignature to generate hash signatures for each document in a pipeline
run_exact_find_dedups: run ExactFindDedups to find duplicate documents using a priority queue over hash signatures
run_exact_dedup_filter: run ExactDedupFilter to remove duplicate documents from a document pipeline
run_exact_dedup_build_index: run ExactDedupBuildIndex to build a deduplication index from signature files
